title: Lena and the Crown
author: Astrid Amberdale
blurb: Vesper Brightwater, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
